title: Florida Clown Squares Up with Police: Cops
description:
Palm Bay police respond to a shopping center after Christopher Marlowe, a 40-year-old homeless man, returns dressed as a clown hours after being trespassed from the area. Officers find a flare gun in his pocket and clown costumes in his backpack before taking him into custody. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.

Law&Crime BodyCam takes you on patrol and in the line of duty with raw footage of police encounters. Grounded in expert narration and insightful commentary from a trusted journalist and attorney, each episode of BodyCam features high-stakes situations with expert analysis.
